method.roi: 15 percent face inset; no resampling; inner minimum dimension 41; margin 20
method.localization: f64 order-8 binomial smoothing, central gradient >=2; normal nonmaximum suppression; strongest per 4x4 cell; maximum 2048 profiles
method.sampling: native grayscale through image::interpolate_bilinear (f32 interpolation, f64 accumulation); normal -15..15, tangent -6..6 averaged
method.profile_smoothing: binomial order 4, kernel [1,4,6,4,1]/16, valid support only
method.contrast: mean last 3 minus mean first 3 >=24 gray levels
method.plateau: endpoint deviation <=0.2*contrast+4; each endpoint 2-pixel span change <=0.5*peak one-pixel profile slope
method.width: first interpolated 90-percent crossing minus first 10-percent crossing, positive native-pixel width
method.support: at least 6 accepted profiles; lower nearest-rank quartile; also report median/p75, contrast and all rejection counts
method.fitter: originals only, one fit; existing 25/75-percent class-extrema gap; missing/overlap rejects whole fit
method.noise_correction: none; no threshold fitted to noise observations or supplied clean reference

notes: 新空间过渡假设，仅 test 编译，不接运行时观测或正式门禁；不是 CPBD 软件或论文的复现。
先在已知 step/flat 上检查。初版漏检截断过渡，失败及代码归档于边缘过渡机制_v1/prototype_1；固定中心对照定位原因后补平台检查，原测试标准不变。
3 个基础测试通过只证明已测合成图形行为，不能预言真实人脸或 384 条件通过。
下四分位数可能偏向毛发或噪声伪边缘；低对比、曲边、纹理和不足支持可能导致未知。保留全部照片，不剔除困难样本。
同一原像素宽度不具有缩图尺度不变性；缩图/暗化/脸框偏移仍仅为敏感性，不新增人工真值。
保留原16条件和筛查底线：噪声/锐化模糊数值误放0、清晰降模糊0、未知<=20%；原图明确定论正确占比>=90%。
来源完全混杂，独立留出0；每类至少20张且人物/拍摄组隔离仍是替换门禁前的必要条件。
